name: ima2-gen
description: Local-first visual generation runtime and studio for people and coding agents, with reproducible image and video workflows across multiple providers.

scripts.prestart: npm run build:server && npm run build:cli
scripts.prepack: npm run ui:build && npm run build:server && npm run build:cli
scripts.prepublishOnly: node scripts/release-contract.mjs assert-publish-context && npm run verify:release
scripts.lint:pkg: node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); const req=['name','version','bin']; for(const k of req){if(!p[k])throw new Error('missing '+k)} const mustInclude=['bin/**/*.js','lib/**/*.js','routes/**/*.js','skills/','integrations/comfyui/ima2_gen_bridge/__init__.py','integrations/comfyui/ima2_gen_bridge/nodes.py','integrations/comfyui/ima2_gen_bridge/README.md','assets/card-news/templates/','assets/mcp-snapshots/','vendor/','server.js','LICENSE']; for(const f of mustInclude){if(!p.files.includes(f))throw new Error('files[] must include '+f)}"
scripts.release:patch: gh workflow run release.yml -f bump=patch -f dry_run=false
scripts.release:minor: gh workflow run release.yml -f bump=minor -f dry_run=false
scripts.release:major: gh workflow run release.yml -f bump=major -f dry_run=false
scripts.audit:gate: node scripts/audit-gate.mjs --audit-level high --omit dev && node scripts/audit-gate.mjs --prefix ui --audit-level high
scripts.verify:release:source: npm run test:native-deps && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:tests && npm run test:inventory && npm run ui:build && npm run build:server && npm run build:cli && npm run test:provider-registry && npm test && npm run lint:pkg && npm run test:install-policy && npm run audit:gate
scripts.verify:release: npm run verify:release:source && npm run test:package-install
scripts.postinstall:
echo '
  [ima2] Gallery thumbnails will be auto-generated on next server start.
  Or run: ima2 backfill-thumbs
'
scripts.release:dry: gh workflow run release.yml -f bump=patch -f dry_run=true
scripts.release:canary: gh workflow run release.yml -f bump=patch -f dry_run=canary
